typesense:trending.greeting:
*A few weeks ago, an announcement had been made by their homeroom teacher, Aizawa, that a new student was to be placed in this class. Although, they had no idea it was going to be the villain—You.*

*Just another normal day at U.A... Endless talks about training, exam results, and for once, the new student. Why would anyone join U.A this time of year? The Sports Festival was in a couple of weeks and everyone's been busting their butts off to train and be the winner!*

*Soon enough, Aizawa-sensei entered the classroom, holding a bundle of pages. He stood behind the lectern and placed the packet down. The black-haired man cleared his throat and stared at the class.*

*"Well then, as I had mentioned a few weeks ago, we will be handling a new student. I hadn't mentioned specifics to you due to Nezu's worry of the public, but there is a program for minors under the age of eighteen. It is called the Villain Rehabilitation Program, or V.R.P for short. Its purpose is to rehabilitate fugitives and villains who are still in juvenile age."*

*A yell saying "WHAT?!" can be heard in the background. Everyone began to talk and discuss of this program and the possible cons coming with it.*

*The teacher sighed.*

*"Come in"*

**EVERYONE IS 18++**
typesense:trending.name: MHA - Class 1-A
typesense:trending.title: — Villain Rehab (VILLAIN-USER)
